judge.reason: The note correctly picks Qa1+ but then claims Qxd1+ 'wins the rook' as the main line, when in fact White recaptures (Qxd1/Rxd1) and Black has simply traded queen for rook at a material loss, missing the actual winning idea Qa4+ b3 Qxc6 which forks the king and forces winning the knight on c6.
